rule: good. all three participants — the wraith, the mire-essence and the lit lantern it is drawn from — survive in one fireable per-wraith rule, and mire-essence keeps its link to essence.
texts: good. the approach is the condition, built from ordinary variables so the rule fires, and the draining is minted per approach and tied to it.
good. a fireable conditional with the nearing as its condition and the pulling as its consequence; every participant, including the lantern the essence comes from, is covered.

mixed: the atoms are all right, but 'a drained lantern' is read as one particular anonymous lantern, so this records a single fact rather than the world rule it looks intended to be — no rule is produced at all. Use a bare plural to get the generalization: 'Drained lanterns burn dimly.'
